RewardBin is a smart waste station designed for schools and community spaces. It detects rubbish deposits, issues digital reward tokens and encourages cleaner shared areas.

See how it works View rewards

The problem

Schools and public spaces often deal with litter even when bins are nearby. RewardBin adds a simple incentive system so people are more likely to dispose of rubbish correctly.

Less litterCleaner shared spaces
More funA reason to use the bin
RewardsTokens people can save

How RewardBin works

A simple system that makes cleaning up feel rewarding.

1

Put rubbish in

Drop your rubbish into the RewardBin.

2

Earn a token

A sensor confirms the deposit and the system awards one token.

3

Redeem rewards

Tokens are saved and can be exchanged for approved school or community rewards.

Designed for students, schools and local communities.
